description: This file implements the <break> element for the MiniLang scripting language within the Ofbiz framework, allowing breaking out of loops during script execution.

classes.name: Break
classes.description: Implements the <break> element for the MiniLang language, raising an exception to indicate a loop break.

classes.name: Break.BreakElementException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a <break> element is encountered without an enclosing loop.

classes.name: Break.BreakFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the Break operation.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the Break operation, throwing BreakElementException to signal a break in loop execution.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the <break> element.

methods.name: BreakElementException
methods.description: Constructs the exception with an appropriate message about missing enclosing loop, including context info.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new Break instance based on the provided XML element and method context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this operation, 'break'.

calls: super(<break> element encountered without enclosing loop)
